subject: City Council Rules of Order and Meeting Frequency
overview: The committee approved a comprehensive update to the Medford City Council Rules of Order, revising agenda formatting, public hearing timelines, and financial transparency requirements. A proposal to move meetings to a bi-weekly schedule remains under review following a debate on balancing legislative efficiency with public access.

items.title: General Rules and Organizational Review
items.summary: The committee reviewed non-substantive copy edits and formatting updates to rules governing council organization, presiding officers, and the duties of the city clerk.

items.title: Rule 12: Order of Business
items.summary: Approved changes to Rule 12 to streamline the agenda by creating a new section for announcements, accolades, and remembrances to handle consensus items more efficiently.

items.title: Rule 19: Public Hearings and Financial Transparency
items.summary: Approved new procedures requiring a six-day public comment period following public hearings and a seven-day written notice requirement for all bond expenditures.

items.title: Rule 16: Public Participation
items.summary: Approved revisions to limit public speakers to five minutes and establish a privacy procedure allowing residents to provide their addresses to city staff rather than into the public record.

items.title: Action on Rule Changes Package
items.summary: The motion passed to report the proposed rule changes out to the full council as amended, excluding the contested rules regarding the meeting schedule.

items.title: Contested Meeting Frequency Proposals
items.summary: Members debated shifting regular meetings to a bi-weekly schedule or to Wednesdays, with proponents arguing for increased subcommittee efficiency while opponents expressed concern over reduced public access and late-night sessions.

items.title: Drafting of Rule 2: Meetings
items.summary: Approved a motion for Vice President Bears to draft final language for a bi-weekly meeting schedule, virtual participation rules, and online posting requirements for meeting materials.
